name: Blinding Smite
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a creature with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The triggering hit deals an extra 3d8 Radiant damage and Blinds the target for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target makes a Constitution save, ending the spell on a success. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d8 per slot level above 3.
